scope: OFFLINE DIAGNOSTIC; PASS means observed baseline behavior reproduced, not acceptance passed

findings.observed: 20/20 synthetic successful callbacks reset fields; not Google runtime E2E.
Server rejection preserves entered fields and releases Save.
Injected render exception after successful server response skips reset and displays generic error. Production trigger remains unproven.
Suggestion closure survives successful reset; keyboard Save without blur then Down/Enter can restore the old title in DOM mock.
In-flight double-click is blocked, but reopening and entering a new draft before old response lets old callback erase it.
500 Shopee maps to 300 ledger base; malformed 390abc accepted as 390; 60 maps to -8; shipping 0/1/2/6/20 = 0/50/60/100/100. Synthetic only.
Cart server accepts Hold, Auction and New Arrival without reservation ownership.
Single sold consumes Hold; inventory.update releases Hold directly, no order-owner check.
Duplicate cart payload for one physical SKU produces two SALES lines.
Failure at inventory Status after ledger append leaves one SALES line; retry creates a second line with a new Order ID.
Single sold writes inventory first; injected ledger failure returns Sold plus sales.error, with no durable recovery journal.
Allocator supports >99, but merely scans SALES; two allocations without a SALES write return the same ID.
Duplicate SKU lookup fails closed; source+SKU remains mutable and is not an immutable item identity.
Injected Status write failure is swallowed by _tryWrite; addInventoryRow still returns success:true.
Omitted Add status defaults to Instock on server, while UI opens New Arrival.
One existing declaration collision: _colLetter in Code/webapp; equivalent for columns 1..16384. All four .gs files parse/load.
Captured Index inline scripts pass syntax compilation.
